article.title: The Look of Election Defense w/Rachel Schragis and Josh Yoder
article.author: Cayden Mak
article.content: Day by day, it’s becoming more difficult to predict any outcomes of the midterms. It’s especially difficult to predict how Republicans might respond to varying degrees of defeat at the polls. President Trump has made his intentions to steal and bribe his way toward a MAGA victory very clear.
